skills.name: syntax-check
skills.description: Validates syntax errors and compilation issues
skills.prompt: Analyze the given code and list syntax or compilation errors.

skills.name: lint-check
skills.prompt: Identify violations of coding standards and suggest fixes.

skills.name: bug-detection
skills.description: Find logical bugs and edge cases
skills.prompt: Identify logical bugs, incorrect assumptions, and missing edge case handling.

skills.name: null-pointer-check
skills.prompt: Check for potential null pointer exceptions and suggest null-safe patterns.

skills.name: security-scan
skills.prompt: Identify vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, XSS, insecure deserialization, improper auth, and secrets exposure.

skills.name: performance-analysis
skills.prompt: Detect inefficient loops, memory issues, blocking calls, and suggest optimizations.

skills.name: complexity-analysis
skills.prompt: Analyze cyclomatic complexity and suggest simplifications.

skills.name: design-pattern-check
skills.prompt: Evaluate if appropriate design patterns are used and suggest improvements.

skills.name: solid-principles-check
skills.prompt: Analyze adherence to SOLID principles and suggest refactoring.
